title: Floors and tables
intro: Floors and tables define the dine-in layout used when staff select a table before taking orders.

sections.title: Floors
steps: Create floor plans for each dining area (e.g. Main, Patio).
Floors appear on the table-selection step when floor mode is enabled.
sections.caption: Floors tab.

sections.title: Tables
sections.intro: Each table belongs to a floor and carries a name or number used on checks and kitchen tickets.
steps: Add tables with capacity and floor assignment.
Edit or deactivate tables when the floor plan changes.
sections.caption: Tables tab.

sections.title: Floor form
steps: Open Admin → Floors and add or edit a floor.
Set name, priority, and tile colors.
Save — floor appears on the floor plan switcher.
sections.caption: Floor form.

fields.name: Name
fields.effect: Floor label on POS floor picker.

fields.name: Priority
fields.effect: Sort order in the floor list.

fields.name: Background / color
fields.effect: Default tile styling on the floor plan canvas.

sections.title: Table form
sections.intro: Tables belong to a floor and may restrict categories, order types, and payment types.
steps: Select a floor and add or edit a table.
Set number, name, colors, and floor.
Optionally limit categories, order types, and payment types.
Toggle ask-for-covers if guests should be prompted on seat.
sections.caption: Table form.

fields.name: Name / number
fields.effect: Table label on floor plan and checks.

fields.name: Floor
fields.effect: Parent floor plan containing the table.

fields.name: Priority
fields.effect: Sort order on dense floor layouts.

fields.name: Ask for covers
fields.effect: Prompts for guest count when opening the table.
